answer: Best defense is slow trust: influence equals account age times honest epochs, so reputation accumulates like nectar, slowly and easily spoiled by one cheat. New clones start at zero weight, so a botnet gains negligible power no matter its size. Every honest act is echoed by witnessing peers who sign the epoch ledger, making collusion visible. For an attacker the cost is basalt-heavy: fund thousands of identities through months of honest waiting, with capital locked and every misstep permanent, so honesty is simply cheaper.
